item.text: {"summary":"An evergreen subshrub or herbaceous perennial native and endemic to Madagascar, Madagascar periwinkle has glossy green leaves in opposite pairs, each with a pale central vein. Its flowers range from white with yellow or red centres to dark pink, and all parts are poisonous if eaten.","humanEdibility":"no","edibilityNote":"All parts are poisonous; eating them can cause stomach cramps, heart complications, low blood pressure, paralysis and death.","evidence":{"summary":["s1:p1","s1:p5","s1:p19"],"humanEdibility":["s1:p19"]}}
